content: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Carter speaking. Are you aware you're being contacted regarding a critical tax irregularity on your account?
No, I had no idea. I just got a voicemail, they said it was urgent about my taxes. What is this about?

According to IRS records, there are discrepancies in your income tax filings from 2021 and 2022. The amount owed has triggered a federal review. Can you confirm your full name and the address listed on your tax returns?
My name is Sunil Rao, and I live at 375 Park Avenue, Apartment 12C, New York. Is this about my H-1B status? I've always filed my taxes properly.

Sir, the IRS has identified a misreporting of income and failure to pay penalties, totaling $6,700 with interest. This is a federal matter now. If this isn't resolved immediately, enforcement actions will be initiated.
Enforcement actions? What does that mean for me?

It means the agency can place a lien on your assets, freeze your bank accounts, report you to immigration, and issue a criminal arrest warrant. Your work authorization and visa status could be revoked.
Oh no, I can't let that happen. Please, I didn't know there was a problem. What do I need to do?
To avoid immediate escalation, you must settle this amount within the next hour. Do you have access to online banking or payment apps right now?
Yes, I have online banking and Venmo, but I don't know if I can pay all at once.
Partial payments are acceptable for now. However, you must make an immediate transfer to the IRS's secure payment partner. Otherwise, your file will be flagged for criminal prosecution.
How do I do that? Do I send money somewhere?
Yes. I will provide you with secure payment instructions in just a moment. Are you able to access your online banking or payment app while on this call? Do not hang up.
I can, yes. But are you sure this is really the IRS? I'm scared.
Sir, this is a federally recorded line. Refusing to cooperate will be taken as willful evasion. Do you want the authorities to arrive at your workplace or home?
No, no, please. I'll do whatever is necessary.
Good. To prevent further action, you must go to a nearby store and purchase $2,000 in Apple or Target gift cards right now. Once you have them, read the codes to me so I can verify the payment.
Gift cards? Isn't there another way? This seems strange.
No, these are authorized methods for rapid settlement under IRS protocol. If you delay, your accounts will be frozen within the hour and deportation proceedings may begin.
I understand. I'll go get the gift cards right now. Please don't call immigration, please.
Stay on the line and do not speak to anyone at the store about this. If asked, say the gift cards are for your own use. Once you have the cards, provide me with the codes immediately.
